Record Class SentenceVectorsOptions

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
opennlp.dl.vectors.SentenceVectorsOptions
Record Components:
pooling - How token vectors are pooled. Not used for a model with a sentence_embedding output. Must not be null.
normalize - true to scale every vector to unit length.
maxLength - The maximum number of tokens per input, including the classification and separator tokens. Longer input is truncated. Must be at least 2.
padding - The padding strategy. Must not be null. PaddingStrategy.AUTO selects the device and model default: SentenceVectorsDL.DEFAULT_GPU_PADDING on a GPU for a token output if the vocabulary has a padding token, SentenceVectorsDL.DEFAULT_CPU_PADDING otherwise. An explicit padded strategy requires a padding token in the vocabulary.
public record SentenceVectorsOptions(Pooling pooling, boolean normalize, int maxLength, PaddingStrategy padding) extends Record
Pooling, normalization, truncation and padding settings for SentenceVectorsDL.
Since:
3.0.0
